checks.finding: Finite rectangle is compact and eta denominator remains positive. d>=0 at both width endpoints. Exact family I+kappa P+d vv* and parameterized G26 supply genuine APPT states for every width/mixing competitor, not a characterization assumption about all spectra.

For R<=K T and alpha>=epsilon*m, u_D/(1+delta_m)>=2 eventually, so D>=2^alpha/K. Explicit supremum alpha*m^2*2^-alpha and exponential width bound prove all V8 errors uniformly, independent of n or alpha. Fixed K thresholds precede the limit K->infinity.

Actual secant estimate and coupled head give V9; middle mean error is O(m^2/D) before exponentiation. Calibration factor (3/u_D)^alpha=(1+2/D)^alpha tends to one only in this branch. All remaining exceptional moments are o(R)<=o(V*) by the physical second-peak gap.

V12 has actual multiplicities k-1 and D-k. Rank rounding <=1/D, trace normalization d/D<=2/D, and removed baseline slot are explicitly controlled uniformly using V8. Calibrated head <=physical numerator head, and scalar numerator >=1; hence the relative lower estimate is valid even when mixing approaches either endpoint.

Pure spike has largest normalized eigenvalue exactly u_D and contributes exactly R to the moment for every alpha>1. No t_D expansion is used here, including alpha>>D. Actual remaining exceptional moments are o(R); middle <=T. Scalar bulk <=(1+2/(m-1))^alpha<=T, because the inherited explicit delta_m=(2/(m-1)+nu_m)/(1-nu_m)>=2/(m-1).

For R>=K T, both moment and scalar lie between R and R+T+o(R), giving uniform discrepancy O(1/K)+o(1). Combine with comparable branch for fixed K, then K->infinity; this proves V2 without an aspect or upper-order condition.

Width endpoint with theta=1/2 has bulk moment ((1+1/m)^alpha+(1-1/m)^alpha)/2. Its log is convex with nonnegative derivative at alpha=1, so it is nondecreasing for alpha>=1. At alpha=epsilon*m it tends to cosh(epsilon)>1. The uniform positive log lower bound justifies relative entropy and additive log error V3.

V18 is independently proved, not inferred from M*/V* convergence. Exact mean-one two-point variance <=1/(m-1)^2 and alpha*width->0 give upper excess. H=ceil(sqrt(alpha*m)) gives variance*m^2->1 and alpha*eta,alpha*log(1+kappa/2)->0, preserving the full calibrated head. Lower error is relative to the sum R+alpha(alpha-1)/(2m^2), for every n>=m.

Above sqrt(m) orders diverge. Any failed uniform sequence admits either alpha/m->0, where V18 and prior G1 control positive moment excesses and hence their logs relatively, or a subsequence alpha/m>=epsilon, where V3 applies even for unbounded alpha/m. Below sqrt(m), U2 gives the stated uniformity. Alpha=1 lies in the continuous finite-order branch.

Asymptotic entropy value as m->infinity across all n>=m and all positive orders is proved. Exact finite optimization, fixed-m limits, all-aspect rigidity, absolute separability and full formalization remain expressly excluded.
